title: Rate Limits: Protect Your Site From Floods of Requests | Orchard Core
description:
A misbehaving crawler, a runaway script, or someone guessing passwords can send a site more requests than it can serve.

The Rate Limits module gives each client a budget of requests, and rejects the requests over it with a 429 Too Many Requests response. You manage its policies in the admin, under Tools, Rate Limits.

In this video:
• Why rate limits, and who shares a budget
• Enabling Rate Limits, and the Default Global Policy
• The types of policy and the types of limiter
• Creating a policy that protects the blog
• Enabling a policy and seeing a request rejected
• Managing policies: search, clone, disable and delete
• The read-only policies that features set
• Shared IP addresses and reverse proxies
• Moving policies between sites
